name: support-popup
description: The free app's support popup (docs/support-prompt.md, section 8), opened from the menu's 'Please Support!' button: it has no 'I already supported' button, and the app never shows 'Supported by you'. 'Get CalcCraft Pro' is never tapped (that opens Google Play). A free build without a paid app ID (the a11ytest build) has no prompt at all: the steps then only check that nothing of it shows.
